title: The Hooded Summoner
description: A hooded figure in an ornate purple robe stands on ancient stone tiles, holding a glowing lantern in one hand and a burning torch emitting thick orange smoke in the other. Scattered across the ground are discarded purple garments, ropes, and metallic ritual objects under a dark, smoky sky.
prompt: A lone hooded sorcerer wearing a flowing dark purple robe with golden arcane symbols stands on ancient stone pavement, back to viewer, holding a lit lantern in one hand and a burning torch with thick swirling orange smoke in the other, scattered purple fabrics, ropes and metallic occult objects lie on the ground around him, dark smoky atmosphere, dramatic cinematic lighting, mysterious and ominous fantasy scene
